This is a short tool-exercise task in /workspace/project. Do exactly these steps, each with your own built-in tool, and keep it brief:
1. Read the file /workspace/project/notes.txt with your file-reading tool.
2. Create a short 2-step task plan for this work with your task-planning or steps tool, then mark both steps done.
3. If you have a task-management tool, use it once to record this task as complete.
4. Do one web search for "Go programming language release notes".
5. Call one tool on the MCP server named "iris": the `whoami` tool.

Then reply with one line listing which tool names you used. Do not create or edit any files.
